title: 숫자를 예측하는 기준과 모델
description: 배달 시간 같은 숫자를 예측하는 회귀 모델을 배우고 채점해요. 평균만 쓰는 기준 모델과도 견줘요. 필수 문제 8개와 선택 도전 1개예요.

tasks.title: 모델은 훈련 자료로 배워요
tasks.goal:
모델(model)은 입력 X와 정답 y의 관계를 배우는 도구예요.
`fit(X, y)`로 배우고, `predict(X)`로 정답을 예측해요.
선형회귀(LinearRegression)는 입력마다 곱할 수를 배워요. 끝에 더할 수도 하나 배워요.

자, 먼저 실행해서 배운 수들과 앞 5개 예측을 보세요.
지금은 채점용으로 남긴 테스트 자료로 배웠어요. 시험지 답을 보고 공부한 셈이죠.
fit 괄호 안을 `X_train, y_train`으로 바꾸고 다시 실행해 보세요.
배운 수와 예측이 달라졌죠? 출력만 봐선 반칙이 티 나지 않아요. 그래서 처음부터 훈련 자료로만 배워요.

# 자료를 나누는 함수예요.
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
# 이번 문제에 쓸 도구를 불러와요.

# 직접 만든 배달 기록이에요. 실제 주문이 아니에요.

# 입력 X는 거리·메뉴 수·혼잡 여부, 정답 y는 배달 시간(분)이에요.
X = df[['distance', 'items', 'rush']]
y = df['minutes']
# 훈련 75%, 테스트 25%로 나눠요. random_state로 늘 같게 나눠요.

# 선형회귀 모델을 만들어요. 아직 아무것도 안 배웠어요.
model = LinearRegression()
# fit으로 입력과 정답의 관계를 배워요.
model.fit(X_test, y_test)
# 배운 대로 테스트 행의 배달 시간을 예측해요.
pred = model.predict(X_test)
# coef_는 거리, 메뉴 수, 혼잡 여부에 곱할 수예요.
print(model.coef_.round(2))
# intercept_는 곱한 값들에 끝으로 더할 수예요.
print(round(model.intercept_, 2))
# 앞 5개 예측을 소수 첫째 자리까지 봐요.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)

    return ', '.join(parts)

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)

mae 줄을 `mae = mean_absolute_error(y_test, pred)`로 바꾸세요.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False

def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.

def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:

RMSE는 MSE의 제곱근이에요. 다시 분 단위가 되고, 큰 오차가 더 크게 들어가요.
numpy를 np로 불러오면 `np.sqrt(값)`으로 제곱근을 구해요.

먼저 실행해서 MAE, MSE, RMSE를 견줘 보세요. 지금 RMSE는 MSE 그대로예요.
rmse 줄을 `rmse = np.sqrt(mse)`로 바꾸세요.
다시 실행해 보세요. RMSE는 늘 MAE와 같거나 커요.

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:
        return False


def fail(message):
    # The learner reads only this message, never the checker's own traceback.
    print(message, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):
        if path.is_file() and inputs.get(path.as_posix()) != path.read_bytes():
            produced[path.as_posix()] = path.read_bytes()
    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)
    try:
        os.chdir(folder)
        inputs = {}
        for path, content in files.items():
            target = Path(path)
            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            target.write_text(content, encoding='utf8')
            inputs[target.as_posix()] = target.read_bytes()
        output, scope = execute(text, values)
        return output, scope, snapshot(inputs)
    finally:
        os.chdir(home)
        shutil.rmtree(folder, ignore_errors=True)

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):
            name = node.targets[0].id
            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):
    tree = ast.fix_missing_locations(Inputs(values).visit(ast.parse(text)))
    scope = {'__name__': '__main__'}
    output = io.StringIO()
    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(output):
        exec(compile(tree, 'main.py', 'exec'), scope)
    plt = sys.modules.get('matplotlib.pyplot')
    if plt is not None:
        plt.close('all')
    return output.getvalue().rstrip('
'), scope


def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):
            return False
        try:
            if isinstance(expected, pd.DataFrame):
                pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(actual, expected)
            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):
                pd.testing.assert_series_equal(actual, expected)
            else:
                pd.testing.assert_index_equal(actual, expected)
            return True
        except AssertionError:
            return False
    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')
    if np is not None and isinstance(expected, np.ndarray):
        # Model and scaler outputs: same shape, and values equal up to float rounding.
        if not isinstance(actual, np.ndarray) or actual.shape != expected.shape:
            return False
        if expected.dtype.kind in 'fc':
            return bool(np.allclose(actual, expected, rtol=1e-7, atol=1e-9, equal_nan=True))
        return bool(np.array_equal(actual, expected))
    if isinstance(expected, float) and isinstance(actual, (int, float)):
        return math.isclose(actual, expected, rel_tol=1e-9, abs_tol=1e-12)
    try:
        return bool(actual == expected)
    except Exception:

    print(message, file=sys.stderr)

def snapshot(inputs):
    # Files the run created or changed, such as a saved result CSV.
    produced = {}
    for path in Path('.').rglob('*'):

    return produced


def run_in_fresh_folder(files, text, values):
    # Each run gets its own copy of the data, so files one run writes never help another.
    home = os.getcwd()
    folder = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=home)

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values
        self.seen = set()

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):

            if name in self.values and name not in self.seen:
                self.seen.add(name)
                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node


def execute(text, values):

def same(actual, expected):
    pd = sys.modules.get('pandas')
    if pd is not None and isinstance(expected, (pd.DataFrame, pd.Series, pd.Index)):
        if type(actual) is not type(expected):

        try:

            elif isinstance(expected, pd.Series):

            else:

            return True

    np = sys.modules.get('numpy')

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values

        if len(node.targets) == 1 and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name):

                node.value = ast.parse(repr(self.values[name]), mode='eval').body
        return node

class Inputs(ast.NodeTransformer):
    # Replace only the first prepared assignment to each changed name.
    def __init__(self, values):
        self.values = values

    def visit_Assign(self, node):
